evidence: POLICY: task/tests/scoring.toml:1-11 is byte-identical to the template (diff SAME; sha256 95f70d6e...bbba): [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; [weights] functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2; [floors] functional=0.05. task/tests/tools/score.py (sha256 13de2b38...c04e) and task/tests/test.sh are also byte-identical to the template. NO REWARD MASS: score.py:46 computes weighted = sum over [weights] only; gate scores appear in the record but never in the sum. Gate judge.toml files (gates/render/judge.toml:14-21, gates/constraints/judge.toml:14-21) use aggregation='all_pass', one binary criterion each; no weight key in [judge]. GATES BEFORE SHAPING / SKIP SCORED: test.sh:212 deletes any stale $LOG_DIR/scored, :213 runs the gates suite, :217 runs score.py, :218-222 exit 1 (gate failure) stops with the detailed zero record and the scored suite at :224 is never launched; any other score.py error writes the plain zero. score.py:41 gates_passed requires each gate > 0.0; :48 reward=0 unless gates_passed and floors_passed; :83 returns 1 on gate failure. A scored-suite timeout (test.sh:224 'exit 0') leaves the first-pass record, which has scored_ran=False -> floors_passed=0 -> reward 0. EXECUTED (evidence/43/score_scenarios.py, result in evidence/43/score_scenarios_result.json; runs the frozen score.py+scoring.toml copied to a temp dir, Python 3.12.10): render gate 0 with perfect scored -> exit 1, reward 0.0, weighted 0.0; constraints gate 0 -> exit 1, reward 0.0; gates pass, no scored output -> exit 0, reward 0.0, floors_passed 0; gate-only app (functional = 1/58.5 = 0.0171, i.e. only hro_job_open+hro_add_candidate, the functional criteria that overlap the gates) with perfect polish and visual -> reward 0.0 (weighted would have been 0.4103) - the floor blocks farming; functional exactly 0.05 -> reward 0.0 (strict >); golden-like all ones -> 1.0; missing gate dimension -> exit 2 (test.sh then writes plain zero). FLOOR ADEQUACY: functional judge has 43 binary criteria totalling weight 58.5 (weighted_mean), so clearing the 0.05 floor needs > 2.925 weight, i.e. real behaviour beyond the two gate-equivalent rows (1.0 weight). Workbook internal note 'passing only the cheap gates earns little' is satisfied: it earns exactly 0. Conforming alternative that could fail: none found - gates are binary pass/fail on behaviours the brief requires (sign-in, server-backed shared job/candidate creation), and the floor/gate thresholds are template-mandated, not task-altered. Broken app that could pass: a gate-passing app with ~3.5 weight of cheap functional rows (e.g. job/candidate creation + anonymous refusal + activity) and strong visuals scores about 0.236 (executed scenario func_3.5of58.5_cheap_rows, polish 0, visual 1); this is a partly working app, not a non-working one, the 0.05 floor and 0.2 visual weight are template/contract-controlled (staged-task-contract.md tests/scoring.toml), and the bound on craft mass belongs to rows 42/44, so it is recorded here only as context, not a row-43 defect.
